description: This file is the JavaScript source code for the jsTree plugin, version 1.0-rc3. It implements a flexible and extensible tree view component for jQuery, including core functionalities, UI interactions, themes, hotkeys, JSON data handling, and various plugins for node manipulation, theming, and keyboard navigation.
external_files: any CSS files loaded via style sheets or theme URLs

classes.name: jsTree._instance
classes.description: Represents a single instance of a jsTree, encapsulating the state, DOM container, and configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the jsTree instance, setting up DOM, loading initial nodes, and attaching event handlers.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the jsTree instance, removing event handlers and cleaning DOM artifacts.

methods.name: load_node
methods.description: Loads data for a specific node, either via JSON, AJAX, or custom data source.

methods.name: create_node
methods.description: Creates a new node under a specified parent with given data and position.

methods.name: delete_node
methods.description: Removes a node from the tree.

methods.name: open_node
methods.description: Expands a node to make its children visible.

methods.name: close_node
methods.description: Collapses a node to hide its children.

methods.name: toggle_node
methods.description: Switches a node between open and closed states.

methods.name: get_text
methods.description: Retrieves the text label of a node.

methods.name: set_text
methods.description: Sets the text label of a node.

methods.name: rename_node
methods.description: Renames a node with a new label.

methods.name: save_opened
methods.description: Saves the current state of opened nodes.

methods.name: reload_nodes
methods.description: Reloads the specified node and its children.

methods.name: set_focus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific tree instance.

methods.name: is_focused
methods.description: Checks if a tree instance is focused.

methods.name: unset_focus
methods.description: Removes focus from a tree instance.

methods.name: check_move
methods.description: Validates whether a node move operation is permissible.

methods.name: move_node
methods.description: Moves or copies a node to a new location.
